rule: Each deep dive is anchored on a top-ranked concept and folds in adjacent survivors that the independent scorers themselves said should be run as a SKU/feeder/feature of it. Coverage: every concept in the top 10 under all three weightings is in a deep dive. Constraint check: >=1 T0/T1 (DD1-DD4) and >=1 T2+ (DD5, whose product stage C-22/C-32 is T2).
post_score_kill_rule: Killed at scoring: default total < 55/100 AND not part of any deep-dive bundle (scorers were unanimous 'pass' on these).
